# Sevens Cleaners — Full Reference

> Professional, on-demand residential cleaning service serving the Greater Houston area. Book online, pay securely via Stripe, get real-time SMS and email updates.

## About

Sevens Cleaners makes it simple to get your home professionally cleaned without making a single phone call. Customers pick a service, choose their date and time window, pay, and get instant confirmation. All cleaners are vetted with government ID verification and background checks. Every service is fully insured.

**Contact:** Support@Sevenscleaners.com
**Service Area:** Greater Houston, Texas, USA
**Website:** https://sevenscleaners.com

---

## Pricing

### Standard Cleaning Services

| Service | Price | Est. Duration |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Bedroom | $120 | ~90 minutes |
| 2 Bedroom | $175 | ~120 minutes |

### Optional Add-Ons

| Add-On | Price | Est. Added Time | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deep Clean | +$50 | +45 min | Baseboards, inside cabinets, window sills & all the spots a regular clean skips |
| Extra Bedroom | +$40 | +30 min | Add a third or more bedroom for a full, thorough clean |
| Inside Oven | +$25 | +20 min | Degrease and scrub burnt residue so your oven looks and smells brand new |
| Inside Fridge | +$25 | +20 min | Wipe shelves, drawers & walls — fresh, odor-free, and ready to stock |
| Move In / Move Out | +$75 | +60 min | Top-to-bottom deep clean to reclaim your deposit or start fresh |
| Pet Hair | +$30 | +20 min | Specialized tools to lift stubborn pet hair and dander from floors and furniture |

A small Stripe processing fee (2.9% + $0.30) is added at checkout. Promo codes are accepted.

---

## What Every Standard Clean Includes

- Kitchen: counters, sink, stovetop & appliances wiped down
- Bathrooms: toilet, tub/shower, vanity & mirrors scrubbed
- All rooms: dusting, vacuuming & mopping
- Trash emptied & bins wiped
- Beds made (linens changed with Deep Clean add-on)
- Interior windows and sliding doors cleaned

---

## How to Book

1. Visit /book on the website
2. Select a service type (1 Bedroom or 2 Bedroom)
3. Optionally select add-ons
4. Enter your service address (validated against service area)
5. Pick a preferred date (next day minimum) and time window:
   - 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM
   - 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
   - 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM
   - 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM
   - 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM
6. Enter contact email (required) and phone (optional, for SMS updates)
7. Apply a promo code if available
8. Pay securely via Stripe Checkout
9. Receive instant booking confirmation by email and SMS

No account required. Booking takes under 3 minutes.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do I book a cleaning?**
Select your service type, choose any add-ons, enter your address, pick a date and time window, then pay securely online. You'll get a confirmation by SMS and email.

**How much does it cost?**
1 bedroom starts at $120 and 2 bedroom starts at $175. Add-ons are available at additional cost. All prices are shown before checkout — no surprises.

**Are your cleaners vetted?**
Yes. All cleaners provide a government-issued photo ID which is verified and securely stored. We only activate cleaners approved by our admin team.

**What areas do you serve?**
We currently serve the Greater Houston, Texas area. Enter your address during booking — if we don't serve your area, you'll be notified before paying.

**What if I need to reschedule?**
Contact support as soon as possible at Support@Sevenscleaners.com. Cancellations within 24 hours of the scheduled time may incur a fee.

**Do cleaners bring their own supplies?**
Some cleaners include supplies; this is noted during the booking assignment. You can add a note if you have specific product preferences.

**How will I know when my cleaner is on the way?**
You'll receive SMS and email notifications when a cleaner is assigned and again when they are in route and when the job is complete.

**Is my payment information secure?**
Yes. Payments are processed by Stripe — a PCI-compliant payment processor. Card details are never stored by Sevens Cleaners.

**What is the satisfaction guarantee?**
If you're not happy with anything, let us know within 24 hours and we'll return to make it right at no extra cost.

**How do I contact support?**
Email Support@Sevenscleaners.com.
